svg.title: \begin{aligned} \log\left(\frac{\mathrm{Pr}(Y=k\mid X=x)}{\mathrm{Pr}(Y=K\mid X=x)}\right) &= \log\left(\frac{\pi_k f_k(x)}{\pi_K f_K(x)}\right) \\ &= \log\left(\frac{\pi_k \exp\left(-\frac{1}{2}(x-\mu_k)^T \mathbf{\Sigma}^{-1}(x-\mu_k)\right)}{\pi_K \exp\left(-\frac{1}{2}(x-\mu_K)^T \mathbf{\Sigma}^{-1}(x-\mu_K)\right)}\right) \\ &= \log\left(\frac{\pi_k}{\pi_K}\right) - \frac{1}{2}(x-\mu_k)^T \mathbf{\Sigma}^{-1}(x-\mu_k) \\ &\quad + \frac{1}{2}(x-\mu_K)^T \mathbf{\Sigma}^{-1}(x-\mu_K) \\ &= \log\left(\frac{\pi_k}{\pi_K}\right) - \frac{1}{2}(\mu_k+\mu_K)^T \mathbf{\Sigma}^{-1}(\mu_k-\mu_K) \\ &\quad + x^T \mathbf{\Sigma}^{-1}(\mu_k-\mu_K) \\ &= a_k + \sum_{j=1}^{p} b_{kj} x_j, \\[1em] a_k &= \log\left(\frac{\pi_k}{\pi_K}\right) - \frac{1}{2}(\mu_k+\mu_K)^T \mathbf{\Sigma}^{-1}(\mu_k-\mu_K), \quad \text{and} \quad b_{kj} \text{ is the } j\text{th component of } \mathbf{\Sigma}^{-1}(\mu_k-\mu_K). \end{aligned}
